caption: The video captures a fixed view of a dense coniferous forest, tall pointed spruces above a few broadleaf crowns, wrapped in pale mist. Thin vertical rain streaks fall continuously, appearing near the top and descending past the crowns in a steady shower. Foreground and mid-ground trees stay sharp and green, while the distant tree line fades into the fog behind them. The framing holds constant, the central and right-hand spruces fixed in place with no evident pan, tilt, or zoom. The mist fluctuates slowly, its brightness shifting across the upper background and left edge, washing out the far-left trees more than the right. The foliage appears essentially static, individual branches showing no clear displacement beyond the passing rain and drifting fog. The shower neither starts nor stops within the visible portion, streaks continuing to drop from first frame to last. The mood stays hushed and wet, the haze softening the forest's depth as rain keeps falling.
